correctness.rationale: The frozen RESULT.md proves strict convexity of total effective resistance in all individual conductances via the inverse-Laplacian trace second variation, forcing the unique symmetry-invariant optimum. The nonzero spectrum of the two-class weighted bipartite Laplacian is 2(a+(n-1)b), nb (n-1 times) and 2a+(n-2)b (n-1 times). Substituting the budget gives scalar objective (cx+n-1)Q_n(x); its derivative at zero yields the displayed rational c_n and the interior root is unique. The result holds for n>=3, B>0,c>0; the formula is mathematical, not merely finite verification.
